explication: Refine is a React meta-framework for CRUD-heavy applications. An application user works through resource pages and UI components; framework hooks coordinate queries and mutations through configured providers, while routing and authentication/access-control shape the experience. The monorepo also supplies UI-framework bindings, backend connectors, Devtools, and project-generation tools. The README documents the product capabilities and sample app wiring; source-index evidence supports selected internal relationships, but unsampled implementations and many package-to-package links are not asserted.
